name: Microgrid failed-black-start indication
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Reports failure to reach the assigned initial-reference conditions during a black-start attempt.
description: Reports failure to reach the assigned initial-reference conditions during a black-start attempt. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Start request and reference feedback” at the input and “Black-start failure alarm” at the output. The alarm should retain its initiating cause.
